summary: formBuilderV2: a page that renders form fields on load can never be navigated away from

ai.s: Fixes a form-builder bug where a page loaded directly with any form field rendered could never be navigated away from client-side.
ai.pr: After a reload or pasted link on a page rendering even one formBuilderV2 field, client-side navigation started but never applied: the URL stayed put with no error.
ai.wy: Frontend routing defect found on the registration form sections work (EP-55965), blocking step navigation.
ai.oc: The cause was bisected to rendering any single form field; the fix is to let navigation complete after a fresh load.

summary: Remove legacy Aventri v2 integration

ai.s: Removes the legacy Aventri v2 integration settings surface now that the Hub Aventri integration has replaced it.
ai.pr: The legacy aventri_v2 settings, log views and controller actions remained after Hub Aventri (EP-46288) superseded them.
ai.wy: Integration migration clean-up: reduce legacy surface and unused infrastructure cost.
ai.oc: After an audit, TAM sign-off and infra check, the legacy views and GeneralController actions are to be removed and docs updated, keeping shared workers.

summary: Switch search engine for Exhibitors list

ai.s: Switches the search engine behind the Marketplace exhibitors list (detail is in a linked Confluence functional reference only).
ai.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title and epic (Switch AI Search for Marketplace).
ai.wy: Part of the Switch AI Search for Marketplace epic; not otherwise specified.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed to move the exhibitors list onto the new search engine.

summary: Remove legacy A2Z (SOAP) integration

ai.s: Removes the legacy A2Z SOAP integration settings surface now that the Hub A2Z REST integration has replaced it.
ai.pr: Legacy a2z SOAP settings, logs and resync actions remained after Hub A2Z REST (EP-45439) superseded them.
ai.wy: Integration migration clean-up: reduce legacy surface and unused infrastructure cost.
ai.oc: After an audit, TAM sign-off and infra check, legacy views and actions are to be removed and docs updated, keeping shared workers.

summary: [TechDept][CLONING-2][BE] Stage 2 — invert the legacy dependency

ai.s: Moves the cloning module's decisions into its domain layer with legacy model access behind ports and adapters, making cloner bugs cheap to unit test.
ai.pr: Every functional defect in cloning lived in entity cloners reachable only through Postgres-backed tests, with four still open on alpha, and legacy models imported the module directly.
ai.wy: Conformance with the new modules architecture and cheaper detection of a proven bug class.
ai.oc: Cloning logic sits in Domain behind ports, so each cloner decision becomes a fast table-driven unit test; the stage is in review.

summary: DS: recover the lost meeting-create events — root cause found, step-by-step restoration plan

ai.s: Finds why meeting-create statistics were being lost and sets out a rehearsed plan to restore them, starting with IMEX event 1295.
ai.pr: The analytics lambda silently dropped client events whose dictionary lookup failed; iOS sent an account id as an exhibitor id, losing 2,884 of 2,912 iOS meetings on event 1295.
ai.wy: Meeting statistics are core client analytics, and IMEX data was materially undercounted.
ai.oc: The root cause is filed (EP-56207) and a step-by-step restoration using the prod-failed backup marker was rehearsed on a dev copy; production is untouched.

summary: AditusVisitors hub: multi external event id sync via SyncJob steps

ai.s: Lets the Hub AditusVisitors integration sync several external event ids by running one SyncJob step per id.
ai.pr: Legacy aditus_v2 could sync multiple external event ids but the Hub AditusVisitors integration could not, blocking legacy removal.
ai.wy: Feature parity needed to retire legacy aditus_v2.
ai.oc: Design decisions on id storage, step execution and per-step cursors are to precede a multi-step build with tests, e2e and docs.

summary: Remove legacy Aditus v2 (InfoSalons) integration

ai.s: Removes the legacy Aditus v2 (InfoSalons) integration settings surface once the Hub AditusVisitors replacement supports multiple event ids.
ai.pr: The legacy aditus_v2 settings surface remained after Hub AditusVisitors replaced it.
ai.wy: Integration migration clean-up, gated on EP-56052 parity.
ai.oc: After the gate, audit and TAM sign-off, legacy views and load/save are to be removed while Aditus v1 mobile badges keep working.

summary: Visit Connect SSO as standalone service with own settings page

ai.s: Extracts Visit Connect (N200) SSO into a standalone service with its own admin settings page, independent of any integration.
ai.pr: N200 SSO was tied to the legacy n200 integration, had no live test coverage and blocked that integration's removal.
ai.wy: Prerequisite for removing legacy n200 while keeping exhibitor SSO working.
ai.oc: A dedicated settings page and SSO service are planned, with the exhibitor menu and endpoint re-pointed, tests added and config migration decided.

summary: N200 flag archaeology — disposition of non-SSO functionality

ai.s: Decides the fate of each remaining non-SSO N200 flag before the legacy integration is removed.
ai.pr: Legacy n200 carried flags such as external badge, external lead scanner, lead sync and category import whose purpose and users were unclear.
ai.wy: Removal of legacy n200 needs a deliberate drop / platform-level / migrate decision per flag.
ai.oc: A per-flag decision table is to be produced, with small platform-level work done in-ticket and user-visible changes documented.

summary: Remove legacy N200 (VISIT) integration

ai.s: Removes the legacy N200 (VISIT) integration settings surface once SSO, flag dispositions and meeting-access mapping are in place.
ai.pr: The legacy n200 settings, logs and seven controller actions remained after Hub Visit replaced it.
ai.wy: Integration migration clean-up, gated on EP-56054, EP-56055 and EP-56057.
ai.oc: After the gates, audit, TAM sign-off and infra check, legacy views and actions are to be removed and docs pointed at Hub Visit and the SSO service.

summary: Conditional Meeting Access as hub mapping field

ai.s: Rebuilds N200's conditional meeting access as an Integration Hub mapping field any integration can use.
ai.pr: Only legacy N200 could block meeting access based on a registration answer, and that logic blocked the integration's removal.
ai.wy: Preserve the capability for all integrations while retiring legacy n200.
ai.oc: A mapping field from source path and match value to ALLOW_MEETINGS is to be designed, built with parity tests and documented.

summary: Filter meeting analytics by meeting tags

ai.s: Organisers can filter meeting analytics by meeting tag, and compare several tags side by side in colour-coded columns.
ai.pr: Meetings analytics showed one blended total, so organisers could not separate or compare co-located shows sharing an event.
ai.wy: Organisers running co-located shows need per-show meeting performance.
ai.oc: A Meeting Tags multi-select beside the Events filter is specified: one tag filters every section, two or more split each metric by tag.

summary: Normalize Alert styles via theme overrides

ai.s: Moves the Alert component's look into expo-react-components theme overrides instead of each app reimplementing it with inline styles.
ai.pr: Alert existed only as a custom per-app wrapper that restyled MUI's Alert with ad-hoc sx for colours, variants, icons and layout.
ai.wy: Design-system consistency and less duplicated frontend code.
ai.oc: Severity colours, variants, icons and spacing are to live in theme overrides so apps use a standard Alert; the change is in review.

summary: Comprehensive pixel-dimension validation for all upload routes (images + media)

ai.s: Applies consistent pixel-dimension validation to both product upload routes so oversized images and GIFs get a 400 instead of a 500.
ai.pr: The /media route had no pixel bound, animated GIFs bypassed the 30 MP ceiling, and images with a side of 32768 px or more caused a 500.
ai.wy: Gaps found in testing after EP-55933; decoded-pixel bombs are a stability risk.
ai.oc: Area and per-side limits, including frames × width × height for GIFs, are to be enforced on /images and /media with field-scoped 400 errors.

summary: Integration Hub: Per-Field "Null if Empty" Control on Field Mappings

ai.s: Adds a per-field "Null if empty" control to Integration Hub mappings so empty source values can be kept from wiping existing data.
ai.pr: When a source API returned null for a populated field, sync overwrote valid data, as when Genesis World wiped exhibitor categories (EP-55214).
ai.wy: Protect client data across all native integrations, not just Genesis.
ai.oc: Each create and update mapping row is to get a checkbox: ticked writes null as today, unticked skips the write and keeps the value.

summary: PDF badge from side menu

ai.s: Attendees in a configured category can open their public transport ticket PDF from the mobile app menu.
ai.pr: There was no way to show an account-specific PDF in the app, so attendees would need to print transport tickets despite having digital ones.
ai.wy: Requested for IMEX Frankfurt (IF27), where Ops is exploring public transport tickets.
ai.oc: A category-restricted burger-menu item is specified, with the PDF pushed per account via a new parameter on Open API POST /api/v2/account/set.

summary: Digital passport — zone-visit stamp collection with tiered rewards (Backend)

ai.s: Adds backend support for a digital passport, recording visitors' zone-visit stamps and resolving their reward tier automatically.
ai.pr: Check-in zones logged presence but had no stamp, count or tier concept, and the leaderboard's points model did not fit.
ai.wy: Organisers of multi-zone events want to encourage exploration with tiered rewards; the mobile story depends on this API.
ai.oc: A provisional scope covers idempotent per-zone stamps, passport-eligible zone flags, configurable tiers and an API; still in discovery.

summary: Digital passport — zone-visit stamp collection with tiered rewards (Mobile App)

ai.s: Visitors can collect digital stamps for zone visits in the mobile app and see their progress toward reward tiers.
ai.pr: Visitors had no way to collect zone-visit stamps or see how close they were to a reward at multi-zone events.
ai.wy: Drive event exploration; the client's first use case is a 3-day event with 9 zones.
ai.oc: A provisional passport screen showing stamps collected versus total and the current tier is planned, blocked by backend story EP-56156.

summary: Align Banners Size FE<>Admin<>Design

ai.s: Aligns banner sizes across frontend, admin and design, which currently all differ.
ai.pr: Banner sizes differed between Figma, the admin panel and the frontend, and some pages such as News had no banner designs.
ai.wy: Related to bug EP-56147; inconsistent sizes make banners display incorrectly.
ai.oc: Banner dimensions are to be made consistent across design, admin and frontend.
